q: What does a cell address such as C7 identify?
why: Cell addresses identify the intersection of a column and row.

options: All repeated IDs are duplicate rows

q: Which field should generally be stored as text if leading zeros matter?
why: Identifiers are labels, not quantities; numeric conversion can remove leading zeros.
